items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I made a record with them

ctx.x: Yeah - and it turned out to be an exact copy of Paul Whiteman -- in the days when Bix was around - so, I made a record with them and I took all the spots on those arrangements that Bix took in the early days and it turned out just beautiful and they treated me fine there and, uh, oh -- the thing when I saw all these guys when I first made my first rehearsal and I saw all these guys around -- they had just played a concert and they looked like a bunch of little penguins; they all had tuxedos on, you know, and I…
